sampling.order: sha256(`<seed>:<row id>`) ascending, one row per record, per country and shape

groupingAssumption: A row's group is its base_source_id when it was derived from a base row, else its own source_id, read up to the last '#', so a base row, its augmentations and the other rendered rows of its record resample together. Distinct rows describing one address from different publishers, and addresses sharing a street or small place, remain separate groups; ids are not source-prefixed, so equal id strings in unrelated sources merge, which widens rather than narrows an interval.
annotationProvenance: Expected spans are the corpus build's alignment of each publisher's address components onto the row text; no row was annotated by hand.
